text:
# filter.conditionMin

TL;DR:
- filter.conditionMin sets the lowest acceptable condition score.

What it means:
- It removes listings whose normalized condition score is below the requested threshold.

Agent hint:
- Use it when the user wants to avoid low-condition items without naming exact buckets.
